description: frozen-latent-16 base (full-budget verified); ~ties PCA-16 0.3726
PCA pre-reduction D->512 before AE; fewer params but lost nonlinear structure, worse
Single hidden [512], no noise, dropout 0.02, no WD, batch 128, LR 5e-3; overfit badly
Larger batch 128 + linearly scaled LR 4e-3; beats PCA-16 (0.3726)
Remove weight decay (1e-5→0); dropout+noise already regularize
Reduce dropout 0.1→0.05; less regularization hurt, noise alone insufficient
Tied decoder weights (transposed encoder); halves params ~5.3M→~2.7M, reduces overfitting
Reduce noise 0.3→0.15; tied weights already regularize — slightly worse
PCA pre-reduction D→256 + single hidden [128]; 35K params, 3531 epochs, new best
Widen hidden [128]->[256]; 71K params, 3530 epochs, slightly worse (no benefit from extra capacity)
Remove denoising noise (0.3→0.0) in PCA space; tied weights+PCA pre-reduction regularize sufficiently
Reduce dropout 0.1→0.02; tied weights+PCA already regularize — slightly worse
Orthogonal init for encoder linear layers; tied-weight W^T W ≈ I preserves norms
Mixup augmentation (alpha=0.2): interpolate training pairs; hurt — off-manifold targets worse
Reduce PCA pre-reduction 256→128; fewer params, more epochs, new best
Gradient clipping max_norm=1.0; slightly worse — gradients already stable
EMA (decay=0.998) replaces SWA; smoothed weights from epoch 0, new best
Reduce PCA pre-reduction 128→64; too few input dims, lost nonlinear structure
Schedule tuning: warmup 5%→10%, LR floor 1e-5→1e-6; better basin + finer convergence
Dropout annealing (0.1→0.0 linearly over training); slightly worse — constant dropout better here
Two-layer funnel encoder [128, 64]; depth hurts at dim-16 too — worse than single [128]
Untie bottleneck decoder layer (independent 16→128 weight); +2K params, slightly worse — tied constraint helps regularize
Larger batch (128→256) + linearly scaled LR (4e-3→8e-3); slightly worse — batch 128 already optimal here
PCA component whitening (unit-variance normalization before AE); model wasted capacity on low-variance components, much worse
Bottleneck BatchNorm on 16-dim latent code; slight regularization overhead, worse than best
Soft orthogonality reg (1e-3) on encoder weights; small overhead, slightly worse
Widen hidden [128]->[256] with PCA_PRE_DIM=128; 38K params, extra capacity doesn't help at dim-16
Gradient centralization on weight matrices; severely disrupted tied-weight training dynamics
Pre-bottleneck residual (h+x in enc, h+r in dec); disrupted BN scale + tied-weight dynamics, worse
EMA decay 0.998→0.999 (wider averaging window); included too-early params, worse
Latent-skip projection (zero-init Linear 16→128 added to first decoder hidden); marginal overhead, slightly worse
Latent noise injection (std=0.1) on 16-dim code during training; noise regularization hurt reconstruction
EMA decay annealing 0.99→0.999 over training; addressed early-param issue but still slightly worse than constant 0.998
Learnable per-component scaling (log_scale param on PCA dims); extra freedom didn't help, slightly worse
SAM (Sharpness-Aware Minimization) rho=0.05; flatter minima but halved epochs (1500 vs ~3500), worse
Asymmetric dropout (enc=0.1, dec=0.0); removing decoder dropout slightly worse — decoder dropout helps regularize tied weights
Latent decorrelation reg (lambda=0.005 off-diag correlation penalty); slight overhead, no benefit — latent dims already sufficiently decorrelated
1-cycle LR schedule (30% cosine ramp-up, div=25); different optimization trajectory but slightly worse than linear warmup+cosine
Mish activation (x*tanh(softplus(x))) instead of SiLU; smoother but no improvement over SiLU
NAdam optimizer (Nesterov-accelerated Adam) instead of AdamW; Nesterov look-ahead didn't help, slightly worse
Learnable Swish activation (x*sigmoid(beta*x), beta trained from 1.0); learned beta diverged from SiLU, slightly worse
LayerNorm on 16-dim latent code (per-sample normalization); bottleneck normalization hurts — too restrictive on code representation
Lookahead optimizer (k=6, alpha=0.5) wrapping AdamW; slow-weight sync disrupted fine optimization trajectory, slightly worse
Gradient noise injection (scale=0.01, noise_std=lr*scale); added exploration but EMA already smooths trajectory, slightly worse
AMSGrad=True in AdamW; step size monotonicity constraint slightly worse — default Adam adaptive step sizes sufficient
Lower Adam beta1 0.9→0.8 (less momentum, more responsive); EMA already smooths trajectory, lower momentum didn't help
Narrow hidden [128]->[96]; 14.5K params, 3606 epochs — capacity loss outweighed epoch gain, worse
Widen hidden [128]->[192]; 28.9K params, 3408 epochs — extra capacity didn't improve, slightly worse
BN cumulative moving avg for EMA stat refresh (reset_running_stats + momentum=None); more accurate BN stats, new best
Progressive dropout annealing (0.05→0.15 over training); increasing regularization didn't help — constant 0.1 better
Post-activation BN (Linear→SiLU→BN→Dropout instead of Linear→BN→SiLU→Dropout); slightly worse — pre-activation BN better for tied weights
Disable dropout during BN stat refresh (eval-mode Dropout while BN trains); minor mismatch, no improvement
Increase LR 4e-3→5e-3; slightly too aggressive, EMA smoothing insufficient to compensate
Per-batch LR scheduling (update LR every batch instead of per-epoch); marginal overhead, no improvement — per-epoch granularity already sufficient
PCA_PRE_DIM 128→160; more input variance but extra low-variance dims didn't help, 23K params, 3413 epochs
Exponential LR decay instead of cosine annealing; log-linear decay spends more time at mid-LR, slightly worse
Decoder code MLP (Linear 16→16 + SiLU before tied decoder); added nonlinear code unfolding, +272 params, slightly worse
Cosine warm restarts (2 cycles) instead of single cosine decay; LR oscillation disrupted EMA convergence, slightly worse
Smaller batch size (128→64); noisier gradients and fewer epochs outweighed extra optimizer steps, worse
Learned per-latent-dim scaling (16 log_scale params, zero-init exp scaling after encoder); optimizer already handles scale via weight matrix, no benefit
Input component dropout (p=0.03) as denoising regularization; zeroing random PCA dims hurt reconstruction, worse than no corruption
Ghost BatchNorm (virtual_batch_size=32); noisier BN stats during training hurt more than they regularized, worse
Denoising noise annealing (std 0.1→0 linearly over training); even annealed noise hurts — tied weights+PCA+EMA already regularize sufficiently
Latent code L2 regularization (CODE_REG=1e-4 on z.pow(2).mean()); soft bottleneck constraint slightly worse — codes already well-constrained by tied weights
Curriculum learning (easy-first by PCA-16 residual norm, 40%→100% over 85% of training); structured ordering hurt — random sampling provides better gradient diversity
